-- Step 1: Create the summary table
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS center_performance_live (
    tx_cen_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    transplant_count INTEGER,
    avg_egs_score NUMERIC
);

-- Step 2: Populate initial data from approved/completed matches
INSERT INTO center_performance_live (tx_cen_code, transplant_count, avg_egs_score)
SELECT 
    a.tx_cen_code,
    COUNT(*) AS transplant_count,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.egs_val) AS NUMERIC), 4) AS avg_egs_score
FROM administrative_and_review a
JOIN risk_evaluation r ON a.adm_rev_registry = r.risk_eval_registry
WHERE LOWER(a.exp_rev_stat_val) = 'approved'
GROUP BY a.tx_cen_code;

-- Step 3: Create the trigger function
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION trg_update_center_performance_fn()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
BEGIN
    -- Update existing center or insert new one when a match is approved
    INSERT INTO center_performance_live (tx_cen_code, transplant_count, avg_egs_score)
    SELECT 
        a.tx_cen_code,
        COUNT(*) AS transplant_count,
        ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.egs_val) AS NUMERIC), 4) AS avg_egs_score
    FROM administrative_and_review a
    JOIN risk_evaluation r ON a.adm_rev_registry = r.risk_eval_registry
    WHERE LOWER(a.exp_rev_stat_val) = 'approved'
    GROUP BY a.tx_cen_code
    ON CONFLICT (tx_cen_code) DO UPDATE SET
        transplant_count = EXCLUDED.transplant_count,
        avg_egs_score = EXCLUDED.avg_egs_score;
    
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS center_performance_live (
    tx_cen_code TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    transplant_count INTEGER,
    avg_egs_score NUMERIC
);

-- Step 2: Populate initial data from completed matches
INSERT INTO center_performance_live (tx_cen_code, transplant_count, avg_egs_score)
SELECT 
    a.tx_cen_code,
    COUNT(*) AS transplant_count,
    ROUND(CAST(AVG(r.egs_val) AS NUMERIC), 4) AS avg_egs_score
FROM transplant_matching tm
JOIN administrative_and_review a ON tm.match_rec_registry = a.adm_rev_registry
JOIN risk_evaluation r ON tm.match_rec_registry = r.risk_eval_registry
WHERE tm.match_status = 'Completed' AND a.tx_cen_code IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY a.tx_cen_code;

-- Step 3: Create the trigger function - updates only the specific center of the changed match
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION trg_update_center_performance_fn()
RETURNS TRIGGER AS $$
DECLARE
    v_tx_cen_code TEXT;
BEGIN
    -- Get the tx_cen_code for this match
    SELECT a.tx_cen_code INTO v_tx_cen_code
    FROM administrative_and_review a
    WHERE a.adm_rev_registry = NEW.match_rec_registry;
    
    -- Skip if no center code or if not completed
    IF v_tx_cen_code IS NULL THEN
        RETURN NEW;
    END IF;
    
    -- Recalculate count and avg EGS for this specific center
    UPDATE center_performance_live
    SET 
        transplant_count = (
            SELECT COUNT(*)
            FROM transplant_matching tm2
            JOIN administrative_and_review a2 ON tm2.match_rec_registry = a2.adm_rev_registry
            JOIN risk_evaluation r2 ON tm2.match_rec_registry = r2.risk_eval_registry
            WHERE tm2.match_status = 'Completed' AND a2.tx_cen_code = v_tx_cen_code
        ),
        avg_egs_score = (
            SELECT ROUND(CAST(AVG(r2.egs_val) AS NUMERIC), 4)
            FROM transplant_matching tm2
            JOIN administrative_and_review a2 ON tm2.match_rec_registry = a2.adm_rev_registry
            JOIN risk_evaluation r2 ON tm2.match_rec_registry = r2.risk_eval_registry
            WHERE tm2.match_status = 'Completed' AND a2.tx_cen_code = v_tx_cen_code
        )
    WHERE tx_cen_code = v_tx_cen_code;
    
    RETURN NEW;
END;
$$ LANGUAGE plpgsql;
